bio.text: Thurman "Bill" Bartie is the Democratic nominee for Texas's 14th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election; he finished second in the March Democratic primary and won the May runoff, according to Community Impact.
Bartie served as mayor of Port Arthur from 2019 to 2025, according to the Port Arthur News.
